Both are gases: they travel only in Pressurized Conduits, Pressurized Cylinders and Gas Cartridges.
# Hydrogen
A Fuel Burner fuel: 60 HU/t at up to 1,400°C, hot enough for Superheated Steam and a Thermoelectric Plant's bonus.
It is a battery, not a power source. Making hydrogen always costs at least 25% more FE than the best setup gets back by burning it, so use it to store power and carry it, not to make it.
# Oxygen
Pipe it into an Arcforge Furnace through an Oxygen port. Each smelt that starts with 50 mB of Oxygen available uses it and runs 1.5× faster.
# Plastic
Light Oil and Hydrogen in a Chemical Reactor make Plastic Sheets, used in Conduit Filters and Storage Upgrades.
